notes.title: HOTFIX 3
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a Unity compatibility bug that would prevent achievements from ever unlocking.
[*] Fixed some dodgy collisions in the father-side invisible path area.
[*] Adjusted movement speed in the Prologue and Chapter 1 openings, to be in line with the rest of the game.
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX 2
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would result in some options to be applied multiple times in a row.
This should fix some issues with setting volume, brightness and mouse sensitivity correctly.
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX 1
notes.content:
Just a small update to mainly address the boss fight being too long/difficult/annoying.

To those who left a negative review [u]mostly [/u]because of the boss fight, please consider giving it a shot again and see if it improves your opinion of the game overall.

[list]
[*] Valves in the boss room now descend/ascend more quickly
[*] The boss has now only one phase, once you hit it it's gone!
[*] Fixed a bug that resulted in some players getting stuck when interacting with the mirror in the blue room.
[/list]

I'm still working on fixing achievements not properly unlocking, please bear with me.

notes.title: UPDATE ON THE GAME DEVELOPMENT
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/a421ea7e9cbca831bfc688aea73e8588ce261fde.png[/img]
Hello, Poopsy here!
As some of you might know, The Lies We Tell Ourselves was originally planned for a [b]Q4 2023[/b] release.

Unfortunately, [b]the last 6 months have been pretty difficult[/b], in terms of personal health and unexpected family loss.
As a result, I've been struggling to find the necessary peace of mind to focus on developing the game, on top of the usual struggle in trying to promote it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/1f78d5495ba69563a0b8d9f1790ebc2aa9a550d9.jpg[/img]
Thankfully, [b]things are getting progressively better[/b] and I'm steadly getting back on track with my development schedule.
However, I will have to make up for the time lost, which means I had to make the tough decision to [b]delay the launch[/b].

Additionally,[b] I only get to release once[/b] and -as a [b]solo dev[/b]- I'm simply too small and invisible to even attempt to compete against any of the amazing titles, big and small, that have been and will be released by the end of this year.

For the sake of clarity, I'm aiming for a [b]Q2 or Q3 2024[/b] release. I will share an actual date as I get closer to my deadline and assess the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/4957a4d040dce6ffc7b5131cabc655506dbb65bd.png[/img]
I deeply [b]appreciate any support[/b] during this time. Whether it's [b]leaving a cute comment[/b], [b]tagging your favorite content creator to play the demo[/b] or simply [b]helping spread the word[/b], your [b]involvement and understanding[/b] mean more than words can express.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050305/b63f9d0ace1b169e318a1b9db0cfecebff43b030.png[/img]
[b]Take care![/b]

notes.title: GAMEPLAY TRAILER, NEW SCREENSHOTS AND MORE!
notes.content:
Hello, Poopsy here!

It's been a while, but I'm here mostly to assure you all that [b]I'm alive[/b] and the [b]game is still very much in production[/b].

The truth is that I'm genuinely terrible at marketing and I prefer to focus my efforts on developing the game rather than promoting it.
Unfortunately, it also means that the general public awareness of The Lies We Tell Ourselves has been quite poor so far, which is a shame.
To partially address the issue, I've decided to participate in the upcoming [b]June edition of the Steam Next Fest[/b], which hopefully will provide the opportunity to showcase the game to a wider audience.

In preparation for the Next Fest, I've decided to [b]take the current demo off the Steam page[/b]: I believe it has served its original purpose (collecting feedback) and by now it's not representative of the final game anymore. The good news is that I'll release an [b]updated demo during the Next Fest[/b], which will be slightly longer in terms of duration and will include the latest game features.
On the same note, I've finally got to [b]update the Steam page[/b] with [b]new screenshots[/b], a better overall [b]description section[/b] and the first [b]gameplay trailer[/b]!

Speaking of updates, the game now features -among other things- [b]full voice acting for the main character[/b], [b]gamepad support[/b] and [b]full multilanguage support for UI and texts[/b] (including audio subtitles).

Finally, speaking of languages, the game has been been professionally translated from English to:

[list]
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] Turkish
[*] Japanese
[/list]
However, all systems are in place to allow for [b]further localizations[/b], so if you're interested in having the game translated in your specific language and you have an excellent understanding of English, please get in touch with me and we might make it happen.

Besides, nothing beats not understanding an incomprehensible story than not understanding it in your OWN native language! ;)

Cheers,
Poopsy
